items.stem: A new teammate needs to view resources in a project but should not change them. Following least privilege, what do you grant?

options.text: A predefined Viewer role scoped to the project
options.rationale: Correct: Viewer grants read access without change rights, scoped appropriately.
Editor allows changes the teammate should not make.

options.text: No role; share your own credentials
options.rationale: Credential sharing breaks accountability and security.

items.explanation: Correct: Viewer grants read access without change rights, scoped appropriately.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about the Google Cloud resource hierarchy are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: projects are the basic container for resources.

options.text: IAM policies can be set at project level and inherited
options.rationale: Correct: policies set higher in the hierarchy are inherited downward.

options.text: A billing account is the same thing as a project
options.rationale: Billing accounts and projects are distinct.
Projects are a primary place to set IAM policies.

items.explanation: Correct: both keyed options are right; the distractors are wrong for the reasons given.

items.stem: You want to be warned before a small project's spend exceeds a set amount. What should you configure?

options.rationale: Correct: budgets with alerts notify you as spend approaches a limit.
Machine size does not warn about spend.
Adding accounts does not create spend alerts.

options.text: Nothing; billing stops automatically at a limit
options.rationale: Budgets alert but do not automatically stop all spend.

items.explanation: Correct: budgets with alerts notify you as spend approaches a limit.
